# Netchan scenario replayed by the C driver (net_chan.c) and net_chan_test.go.
# Channels: c = NS_CLIENT, s = NS_SERVER.
time 1000
setup c 12345
setup s 12345
time 1010
tx c 0102
rxlast s c
rel s 0b6e657700
tx s 070707
rxlast c s
# client acks the reliable
time 1020
tx c -
rxlast s c
tx s -
rxlast c s
# server queues reliable; packet dropped, then resend detection
rel s 0d11223344
time 1030
tx s aa
# dropped: client never sees it; client sends acks of old seq
tx c bb
rxlast s c
tx s cc
rxlast c s
tx c dd
rxlast s c
# now incoming_acknowledged > last_reliable_sequence and rack != rel -> resend
tx s ee
rxlast c s
tx c -
rxlast s c
tx s -
# duplicate / stale delivery
rxlast c s
rxlast c s
# client reliable while server reliable pending
rel c 0463616d00
rel c 0564
tx c 11
rxlast s c
rel s 0e
tx s 22
rxlast c s
tx c 33
rxlast s c
tx s 44
rxlast c s
# crafted packets: seq jump (dropped count), high bits
time 2000
rx c 0a000080030000800102
rx c 05000000030000000102
rx c 20000000ffffff7f
rx c 21000000
rx c ff
# unreliable too large gets dumped
txfill s 1395
txfill c 1380
# reliable overflow -> fatal
relfill s 1000
relfill s 500
tx s 01
relfill c 1384
tx c 02
# max reliable plus unreliable fits exactly
setup c 7
relfill c 1384
txfill c 4
txfill c 1390
setup s 65535
tx s -
rel s 01
txfill s 1386
